content.short: Gondi is a decentralized NFT lending platform delivering faster, cheaper loans with flexible terms.
content.description: Gondi is a decentralized, non-custodial NFT lending protocol designed to foster an efficient NFT credit market. It supports continuous underwriting, enabling full and partial refinancing of all outstanding loans, which keeps liquidity dynamic and the market more responsive. Through Gondi, lenders can instantly refinance any existing loan, and borrowers can access more favorable terms on their outstanding loans, with improvements realized passively over time as refinancing activity unfolds.
